speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't shared any symptoms yet; could you please describe exactly what you are feeling, especially regarding your fatigue, itching, and any other issues? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the combination of severe itching, fatigue, and your sexual history raises concerns for hepatitis. Have you experienced any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently? Also, have you noticed any unintentional weight loss or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

I notice you have scleral icterus and scratch marks; given your history of ulcerative colitis, we must confirm if this is PBC or an overlap syndrome. Please request your latest liver function panel, specifically looking for antimitochondrial antibody (AMA) and alkaline phosphatase levels. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel_with_AMA
